full_judgment: The appellants as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit Nos. 75 and 76 of 1965 in the Second Court of Subordinate Judge, Barisal for declaration of their raiyati rights in the suit 1 and 5, plaintiffs case in short is that the karsha recorded in D.R. khatian No. 374 measuring 23.72 sores belonged to Sadat Ali and others and the said korsa was held under the Hawla Abdul Kader and by successive transfers as well as by inheritance the plaintiffs acquired the said entire 23.72 sores of land; that out of the said and only 12.99 acres have been recorded in the R.S. and S.A. Khatians as the original land; and that the remaining 10.77 acres of land were diluviated in the river beginning from 1351 B.S.; that some time after 1351 B.S. when the R.S. operation was started the eastern part of original plot No. 66 and entire land of 67 to 73 were under water and the said diluviated lands and other wurrounding lands of other persons were recorded under khatian No. 441 as river and it was recorded in the remark column of the khatian, that if the lands reappear within 20 years, the provisions of section 86F of B.T. Act would be applicable there to; that 7/8 years there after the river began to recede on the eastern side and the said lands reformed in situ within next 4/5 years; that the said river receded further and more land acted to the said lands reformed in situ; that the plaintiffs claimed 10.73 acres as the reformation in situ and the rest as accretion thereto, in total claiming 140.56 acres of land; that in April, 1963 the plaintiffs applied to the Deputy commissioner (Revenue) Barisal for assessment of rent but the R.C.O. being required to submit his report claimed the lands as the khas lands of the Government.
